fusions.name: Crushing Hug
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health: a crushing hug that deals 22 damage plus 1.5 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up, and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ground-Shaking Slam
fusions.desc: You rear up and slam down, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Den Up
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You restore 15 health.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15 and your physical resistance by 6%.
